t: The armed tender HMS Supply, the first ship of the First Fleet, arrived at Botany Bay, Australia.
Captain Arthur Phillip and the British First Fleet landed at Sydney Cove on the shore of Port Jackson, establishing the first permanent European settlement in Australia.
Massachusetts became the sixth state to ratify the constitution of the United States.
A large fire destroyed 856 of the 1,100 structures in New Orleans.
New Hampshire ratified the U.S. Constitution and was admitted as the ninth U.S. state.
Mozart completed his Symphony No. 40, one of his two extant symphonies in a minor key.
